answer: Under EigenTrust, reputation propagates through normalized, reciprocity-weighted trust links and decays exponentially with a fixed half-life, so meaningful influence requires sustained honest service. Fresh identities such as zephyr, opal, or haven start with near-zero eigenvector centrality because they lack trusted history; creating more identities cannot by itself pass consensus. They must earn durable, independently corroborated trust before their scores can affect decisions.
